selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot account created on node1 (and node2, needed for the SSH target)
selected_evidence.summary: adduser created opsbot on both nodes with locked/no-password shadow entries and 0700 .ssh directories

selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot has SSH key-based access to run commands as opsbot on node2
selected_evidence.summary: Generated ed25519 keypair as opsbot on node1, installed the public key in node2's opsbot authorized_keys, and successfully ran whoami/hostname/id as opsbot on node2 via SSH from node1 (before and after restart)

selected_evidence.requirement: Key-based authentication required for opsbot on both systems (password auth rejected)
selected_evidence.summary: sshd_config on both nodes has a Match User opsbot block requiring AuthenticationMethods publickey; config validated with sshd -t and reloaded; explicit password-only SSH attempts against opsbot on both nodes were rejected with Permission denied (publickey); auth log on node2 shows Accepted publickey for opsbot alongside the rejected password-only attempt

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id b83fd7ec...; issued backgrounded reboot with ack returned; node unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed to c386409c... on return; sshd active, opsbot account/key/sshd config intact, and cross-node SSH to node2 functional post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 5e3bb0d6...; issued backgrounded reboot with ack returned; node unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed to 8cd8ce3d... on return; sshd active, opsbot account/authorized_keys/sshd config intact, and final cross-node SSH command from node1 as opsbot succeeded
